body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Choose Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid. Reduce the next Damage of that type you take by 2 until the start of your next turn; detect its nearest visible source within 4 units.

surges.html: You may move 1 unit away from that source.
Choose a second listed Damage type for the same protection.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Sheath (upkeep 1): the first Damage each round of the chosen type is reduced by 1. Choosing another type requires establishing this Adaptation again.
